title: Python launcher py not recognized in PowerShell
root_cause: The Python launcher directory was not registered on PATH in the terminal session, whereas python was directly available as Python 3.12.0.
fix: Used python -m venv .venv to initialize the virtual environment directly with Python 3.12.
next_time: Check Get-Command python and installed binaries before assuming py.exe is on PATH.

title: Pip package installation blocked by sandbox network isolation
symptom: Running pip install in sandbox mode failed with Errno 11001 getaddrinfo failed.
root_cause: Sandbox isolation blocks outbound network access to external hosts including PyPI.
fix: Executed pip installation with network access enabled outside the sandbox.
next_time: Package installation from remote package indexes must be executed with network access.

title: Environment variables not propagated to existing process session
symptom: Process environment variables JOOBLE_API_KEY and SUPABASE_DB_URL were missing in the current shell session.
root_cause: User environment variables added after the process launched are not automatically propagated to running sessions without restarting or reading from registry.
fix: Added Windows registry fallback in scripts/apply_schema.py to retrieve User-level environment variables when process environment is stale.
next_time: Check user registry directly or restart terminal session when verifying newly created variables.

title: Groq API models request blocked with HTTP 403 Forbidden
symptom: GET request to https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/models failed with HTTP Error 403: Forbidden.
root_cause: Default Python-urllib User-Agent header was rejected by Cloudflare or Groq edge firewall.
fix: Configured an explicit User-Agent header (curl or fresher-radar/0.1) on outgoing HTTP requests.
next_time: Always specify a descriptive or standard User-Agent header for external API interactions.

title: CI editable pip install failed on flat-layout discovery
symptom: GitHub Actions CI failed during pip install -e ".[dev]" with error "Multiple top-level packages discovered in a flat-layout: ['db', 'config']".
root_cause: pyproject.toml lacked explicit setuptools package discovery settings. Setuptools automatic discovery encountered multiple non-package directories at repository root and aborted.
fix: Added explicit [build-system] and [tool.setuptools.packages.find] to pyproject.toml, targeting pipeline packages and excluding non-package root directories.
next_time: Explicitly configure package discovery in pyproject.toml when using a flat layout with non-code root directories.

title: Jooble API returned HTTP 403 on global domain
symptom: POST request to https://jooble.org/api/<REDACTED> returned HTTP Error 403: Forbidden.
root_cause: Jooble issues domain-specific regional API keys. An API key created for the Indian portal must be queried via in.jooble.org rather than the global jooble.org domain.
fix: Configured base_url in config/sources.yaml and pipeline/sources/jooble.py to https://in.jooble.org/api.
next_time: Verify regional domain bindings when working with international aggregator partner keys.

title: Candidate Greenhouse tokens failed with HTTP 404
symptom: 28 out of 43 initial Indian startup candidate tokens (e.g. postman, razorpay, swiggy, cred) returned HTTP 404 from boards-api.greenhouse.io.
root_cause: Those organizations use alternative ATS providers or customized enterprise board slugs rather than public greenhouse.io tokens.
fix: Created an automated validation probe and discovered 32 confirmed, active companies hiring in India with public Greenhouse boards.
next_time: Probe ATS endpoints against public lists before hardcoding company board tokens.

title: Cached sample fallback caused synthetic duplication across all queries
symptom: All 48 Jooble queries reported 20 posts and Greenhouse boards returned 2 posts each in dev mode.
root_cause: Missing query-specific cache files caused adapters to fall back to jooble_sample.json and greenhouse_sample.json for every query and board.
fix: Removed fallback to sample stubs. Configured adapters so that in cache mode, missing files log a cache miss and return zero posts. Each query writes its own discrete cache file immediately upon live receipt.
next_time: Never fall back to a single shared fixture file when testing multi-query pagination pipelines.

title: Httpx client logged Jooble API key in live request URLs
symptom: Httpx default logger outputted full request URLs containing the Jooble API key at INFO level during live queries.
root_cause: Jooble API requires passing the key as a URL path segment, and httpx logs outgoing URLs by default when logger is set to INFO.
fix: Suppressed httpx and httpcore loggers to WARNING level, and registered a RedactKeyFilter on the root logger to sanitize any occurrences of the key.
next_time: Ensure third-party HTTP client loggers are silenced or filtered whenever sensitive tokens reside in URL paths.

title: Missing standard module re import in pipeline run entrypoint
symptom: Invoking python -m pipeline.run --stage filter crashed with NameError: name 're' is not defined.
root_cause: Added title regular expression audit logic to run_filter_stage in pipeline/run.py without importing re at module top.
next_time: Run static linting (ruff check) before invoking new CLI command stages.

title: Entity-encoded HTML tags in Greenhouse descriptions escaped tag stripping
symptom:
Normalized descriptions from Greenhouse contained raw HTML tags like

and

.
root_cause: Greenhouse payload was entity-encoded (<h3>). clean_text ran HTML_TAG_REGEX.sub before html.unescape, so tags were not stripped and were subsequently unescaped into raw HTML tags.
fix: Updated clean_text in pipeline/normalize.py to loop unescape (up to 3 passes to handle double-encoding), strip scripts, styles, comments, and HTML tags, unescape once more, and normalize whitespace.
next_time: Unescape HTML entities before running tag-stripping regular expressions.

title: Overly broad single-word keywords falsely rejected real job posts
symptom: 19 legitimate job posts (e.g. CA Article Trainees, Admission Counsellors at institutes, Junior Associate AR, Marine Engineers, Databricks engineers) were rejected with rule_reason not_a_job_post.
root_cause: Standalone words admission, cohort, and course in not_job_keywords matched on general phrases like "patient admission", "admission control", "cohort analysis", "CA course", and "during the course of employment".
fix: Removed single words admission, cohort, and course from not_job_keywords. Replaced them with specific multi-word program advertising patterns (admissions open, join our cohort, certification course), and added title role exemptions for real occupations (e.g. article trainee, admission counsellor, telecaller, customer success manager, associate ar, marine engineer).
next_time: Never use broad common nouns as standalone rejection keywords; require phrase-level context for non-job classification.

title: Unit test for UsageCounter failed due to live Supabase DB query
root_cause: UsageCounter.__init__ fell back to os.environ.get("SUPABASE_DB_URL") when db_url was not provided, connecting to the real DB table instead of isolating to the temporary test file.
fix: Added use_db=False parameter to UsageCounter and updated unit tests to disable DB access for isolated tests.
next_time: Explicitly isolate test dependencies from environment variables connecting to remote services.

title: Role Taxonomy Drift in Tagging Prompt v2 and Model Aliasing
symptom: In benchmark scoring, all models produced role classifications "human_resources" and "operations_supply_chain" which mismatched ground truth labels (hr_recruitment, operations_logistics), while JSON validity incorrectly reported 100%.
root_cause: During prompt v2 drafting, role definition keys were added as human_resources, finance_accounting, and operations_supply_chain instead of canonical taxonomy enum values. Role enum in pipeline/llm/base.py was also given temporary aliases for these strings, so Pydantic passed them without validation errors.
fix: Restored Role enum to strictly the 22 canonical taxonomy roles in base.py and taxonomy.yaml. Created tag_v3.txt with correct canonical names (hr_recruitment, finance_banking, operations_logistics). Updated repair prompt to explicitly restate the allowed enum lists for role, city, and post_type on validation failure.
next_time: Never introduce model-level enum aliases that drift from the database schema CHECK constraints and ground-truth taxonomy.

title: Database post_type CHECK Constraint Rejected Valid Taxonomy Enums
symptom: Schema check constraint jobs_post_type_check only permitted values 'job' and 'internship', risking constraint violation for valid posts with post_type 'trainee' or non-job classifications.
root_cause: The initial database schema definition restricted post_type to ('job', 'internship') while the application PostType enum and benchmark posts included 'trainee', 'fellowship', 'course_or_workshop', 'event', and 'other'.
fix: Updated jobs_post_type_check in db/schema.sql to allow all seven taxonomy post_type values ('job', 'internship', 'trainee', 'fellowship', 'course_or_workshop', 'event', 'other') or NULL. Applied the schema to Supabase and added unit tests in tests/test_bootstrap.py.
next_time: Align database schema check constraints directly with the application enums from day one.

title: Job Identity Divergence on Lifecycle Transitions
symptom: 8 extra rows in jobs table (1,489 rows vs 1,481 raw_posts) when stale posts were re-evaluated.
root_cause: jobs table used canonical_key as the unique constraint. Survivors used sha1(company|title|city) while rejects used sha1(rej|source|source_id). When an accepted post crossed 45 days and was re-evaluated as stale, the upsert generated a new rej|... key and inserted a duplicate row rather than updating the existing row in place.
fix: Migrated jobs identity to UNIQUE (source, source_id). Re-routed dedup grouping to a non-unique dedup_key column. Deduplicated existing records while preserving all 440 tagged rows. Added invariant enforcement script check_invariants.py.
next_time: Anchor entity identity to the source record identifier rather than volatile evaluation-dependent hashes.

title: Next.js Build-Time Type Error on Duplicate Property Identifier
symptom: next build failed with Type error: Duplicate identifier 'source' in src/lib/types.ts.
root_cause: When adding source and source_id to the Job interface, source was already declared further down in the interface.
fix: Removed the duplicate source: string declaration from Job in web/src/lib/types.ts.
next_time: Run tsc --noEmit before triggering full production builds.

title: Uncached Database Query in Global Header Caused 200ms Latency
symptom: Warm page requests to home page took over 200 ms despite cached job query results.
root_cause: Header.tsx executed getLastRefresh() directly to Supabase Tokyo on every render without caching.
fix: Wrapped getLastRefresh() in web/src/lib/jobs.ts with Next.js unstable_cache (300-second revalidation, tags: ["runs"]). Also wrapped /api/jobs in getCachedJobs. Warm latency dropped from 200 ms to 62.3 ms for HTML SSR and 7.6 ms for the API route.
next_time: Audit all global layout and navigation components to ensure zero uncached database queries on warm page loads.
